content_sections.heading: About PJTAU
content_sections.text: Professor Jayashankar Telangana Agricultural University is an agricultural university, and this recruitment is for its Maize Research Unit at ARI, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad. The posts serve the PJTAU – ICAR-NMHYS project on maize, under the National Mission on High Yielding Seeds during 2026-27. The notice is issued by Dr. D. Bhadru, Principal Scientist (Pl. Br.) and PI of the NMHYS Project.

content_sections.heading: PJTAU Project Associate-II and Field Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: For Project Associate-II (YP-II), the notice prefers an M. Sc. in the Dept of Genetics & Plant Breeding, Bio technology, Entomology or Pathology. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice names one stage for both posts: an interview at the Maize Research Unit.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Each post is on a temporary basis, and the notice calls it purely temporary on a consolidated basis. The notice prints the duration of the scheme as up to 31 March 2026. That date falls before the notice date, although the scheme is named for 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PJTAU Project Associate-II and Field Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a brief Bio-Data. Keep 2 sets of xerox copies of your certificates, along with the original certificates. Go to the O/o Principal Scientist & Head, Maize Research Unit, ARI, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad-500030 on 9 November 2026 at 11.00 AM. Submit the Bio-Data and the xerox copies at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. Which project are these PJTAU posts for?
faq.answer: Both posts are for the PJTAU – ICAR-NMHYS project on maize at MRU, ARI, Rajendranagar, under the National Mission on High Yielding Seeds during 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. Can a candidate with a Diploma in Agricultural Polytechnic attend?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Field Assistant post, which has this diploma as its minimum qualification. The Project Associate-II (YP-II) post requires an M. Sc. in Agriculture/Horticulture.

faq.question: Q3. Which M. Sc. specialisations are preferred for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: The preferred areas are Genetics & Plant Breeding, Bio technology, Entomology and Pathology.

faq.question: Q4. How many copies of certificates are required?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit 2 sets of xerox copies with a brief Bio-Data and also bring their original certificates.

faq.question: Q5. Will candidates get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be given to candidates appearing for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a contact for the Maize Research Unit?
faq.answer: The notice prints the mobile number 8333818245 and the email address [email protected] on its letterhead.
